utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Carson' by name among the cities in its service area. Carson's own Clean Power Alliance page also confirms SCE continues to deliver power, bill, and handle service issues.

value.name: Clean Power Alliance (CPA) - Lean Power (default, 36% renewable content)
value.notes: Confirmed directly via the City of Carson's own page (ci.carson.ca.us/publicworks/CleanPower.aspx): 'Our community has selected Lean Power as our default option.' Carson joined CPA in late 2017; residential service began February 2019.

county.notes: Carson is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Carson Community Development Department, Building and Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: Building Division inspections are conducted Monday through Thursday via the Civic Access portal
Fire Department inspection is required before system activation — contact the Los Angeles County Fire Department, Fire Prevention Division at (323) 890-4125 to schedule and pass an inspection

value.notes: The City's own SolarApp+ Submittals page describes SolarAPP+ as automating plan reviews so applicants 'receive an automated permit' after submitting design and paying fees online — i.e. same-day/instant issuance for SolarAPP+-eligible projects.

eligibility_constraints.notes: The page does not specify system-size or property-type eligibility limits.

permit_fees.notes: The page states the system will invoice permit fees upon approval-ID entry, but no dollar amount is given.

value.role: Los Angeles County Fire Department, Fire Prevention Division
